name: Somerset Pour House
description: The venue is a lively karaoke bar that offers a vibrant atmosphere with live music, karaoke nights, and dance floors. It features a stage for performances and a friendly crowd, making it an ideal spot for socializing and entertainment. The venue is well-maintained, with friendly staff and a good selection of drinks and food. It hosts karaoke events primarily on weekends and Thursdays, creating a fun environment for both casual and dedicated karaoke enthusiasts.
